stem.flightsim.coaching_mission_complete: Mission completion and the return landing were recorded. Try this mission again with one deliberate control or route change, then compare the saved observations.
stem.flightsim.coaching_mission_depleted: The drone ran out of charge. Start a fresh mission, use short routes, and plan a return before the battery is low.
stem.flightsim.coaching_mission_unknown: This mission has incomplete or conflicting evidence. Review what was recorded, then start a fresh attempt.
stem.flightsim.coaching_mission_capture: Some targets remain uncaptured. On a fresh mission, approach one target at a time and hold within the displayed height and ground-speed limits until capture is recorded.
stem.flightsim.coaching_mission_recovery: The survivor was not recovered. On a fresh rescue, practice a stable hover within the displayed height, drift, and vertical-speed limits before returning to base.
stem.flightsim.coaching_mission_return: Pickup or capture objectives were recorded; the return landing remains. Start a fresh mission, then reserve time and battery for returning to base.
stem.flightsim.mission_reflection_prompt: Which target, hover, or return decision would you change? Use the mission observations to explain your choice and plan one change for a fresh attempt. Your explanation saves with this flight.
stem.flightsim.journal_different_airport: These approaches used different airports. Review their observations separately; measurement changes are not calculated.
stem.flightsim.challenge_brake_release: Release X and turn off Wheel Brakes in Deck before adding power.
